source_message.speaker: client
source_message.text: The case needs to accommodate all 3 boards and the 18650 battery, with a cover that has a display cutout; I still need to choose between a 2.1 and 4.2 display. The display should be the cover's only mount, and both connecting it and fitting the cover onto the case should be easy. Every board and the lithium-polymer battery must have mounts on the base, and I can provide pictures of the current design. Air should enter below the sensors and exit through the top. For the LEDs, I can either place a semi-transparent plexiglass strip above them or use a grid pattern that allows the light through.

value_updates.cover_installation_requirement: easy to fit onto the case
